target_column.description: Name of the categorical target column. Every other non-dropped column is a feature.

drop_columns.description: Comma-separated columns to exclude from features, such as identifiers or raw timestamps.

max_train_rows.description: Maximum rows retained for task-specific training after validation. Sampling is deterministic and stratified.

validation_split.description: Stratified holdout fraction used only when val.csv is absent.

fine_tune.description: Update TabPFN weights on the uploaded task. Requires CUDA. When false, run TabPFN as an in-context classifier without gradient updates.

model_version.description: TabPFN generation. v3 is the current default generation; use default to follow the installed package default.

learning_rate.description: AdamW learning rate for task-specific fine-tuning.

early_stopping_patience.description: Validation epochs without improvement before early stopping.

eval_metric.description: Primary validation metric used by TabPFN during fine-tuning.

n_finetune_ctx_plus_query_samples.description: Maximum context-plus-query samples drawn per fine-tuning epoch/batch configuration.

n_estimators_finetune.description: Ensemble estimators used inside the fine-tuning loop.

n_estimators_validation.description: Estimators used for validation during fine-tuning.

n_estimators_final_inference.description: Estimators retained for the final fitted inference model.

prediction_batch_rows.description: Validation/test prediction chunk size used to bound peak memory.

seed.description: RNG seed used for stratified sampling and TabPFN fine-tuning.
